tasks.title: Create REST API Endpoint Structure
tasks.description: Set up the basic structure for REST API endpoints in the Fastify server alongside existing gRPC services.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the router setup and configuration
2. Test that CORS is properly configured
3. Verify error handling middleware catches and formats errors correctly
4. Ensure all route prefixes are registered correctly

subtasks.title: Create REST API Directory Structure
subtasks.description: Set up a new directory structure for REST API endpoints within the Fastify server project.
subtasks.details: Create a new 'rest' directory under 'src/api'. Within 'rest', create subdirectories for 'routes', 'middleware', and 'controllers'. This structure will separate concerns and improve code organization.
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify the existence and correct structure of the newly created directories using file system checks in a unit test.

subtasks.title: Implement Base Router Configuration
subtasks.description: Set up the base router configuration for REST endpoints in the Fastify server.
subtasks.details: Create an 'index.ts' file in the 'src/api/rest' directory. Implement a 'setupRestApi' function that initializes Fastify plugins, registers route handlers, and sets up basic configurations like CORS and error handling.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write integration tests to ensure the base router is properly configured and can handle basic requests.

subtasks.title: Configure CORS for REST Endpoints
subtasks.description: Implement CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) configuration for the REST API endpoints.
subtasks.details: Use the '@fastify/cors' plugin to configure CORS settings. Set up options to allow specific origins or use a wildcard. Ensure credentials are properly handled if required.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests to verify CORS headers are properly set on responses. Include tests for both allowed and disallowed origins.

subtasks.title: Implement Request Logging Middleware
subtasks.description: Create and integrate middleware for logging incoming REST API requests.
subtasks.details: Develop a custom middleware function that logs relevant information for each incoming request, such as method, URL, headers, and body (if applicable). Integrate this middleware into the Fastify server configuration.
subtasks.testStrategy: Use mock objects to test if the logging middleware correctly captures and formats request information. Verify log output in integration tests.

subtasks.title: Set Up Error Handling Middleware
subtasks.description: Implement error handling middleware for the REST API to manage and respond to various types of errors consistently.
subtasks.details: Create an error handling function that catches both synchronous and asynchronous errors. Implement logic to determine appropriate status codes and error messages. Integrate this handler using Fastify's setErrorHandler method.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for the error handler function with various error scenarios. Perform integration tests to ensure proper error responses are sent for different types of errors (e.g., 404, 500).

tasks.title: Implement Shared Type Definitions
tasks.description: Create a shared type system between backend and frontend to maintain type safety during the migration.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Write unit tests for schema validation
2. Test edge cases for each schema
3. Verify type inference works correctly
4. Test schema composition for complex objects

tasks.title: Implement Authentication REST Endpoints
tasks.description: Create REST endpoints for authentication that mirror the existing gRPC authentication service.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test each authentication endpoint
2. Test successful login/registration flows
3. Test error cases (invalid credentials, already registered)
4. Verify JWT token generation and validation
5. Test token refresh functionality

tasks.title: Implement User Profile REST Endpoints
tasks.description: Create REST endpoints for user profile operations that mirror the existing gRPC user service.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test each user profile endpoint
2. Test authentication middleware integration
3. Test successful profile retrieval and updates
4. Test error cases (user not found, validation errors)
5. Verify database interactions

tasks.title: Implement Training Plan REST Endpoints
tasks.description: Create REST endpoints for training plan operations that mirror the existing gRPC training service.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test each training plan endpoint
2. Test authentication integration
3. Test successful plan retrieval and updates
4. Test error cases (plan not found, validation errors)
5. Verify that business logic remains intact

tasks.title: Implement Training Feedback REST Endpoints
tasks.description: Create REST endpoints for submitting training session feedback that mirror the existing gRPC feedback service.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the feedback submission endpoint
2. Test validation of different feedback types
3. Test error cases (session not found, invalid feedback)
4. Verify that feedback is properly stored
5. Test integration with AI adaptation service

tasks.title: Implement Training Suggestions REST Endpoint
tasks.description: Create REST endpoint for generating training progression suggestions that integrates with the OpenAI API.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the suggestions endpoint
2. Mock OpenAI API responses for testing
3. Test error cases (insufficient data, API failures)
4. Verify that suggestions are properly formatted
5. Test integration with the training plan service

tasks.title: Create REST API Client for Mobile App
tasks.description: Develop a REST API client for the mobile app to replace the existing gRPC client.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the API client methods
2. Mock API responses using axios-mock-adapter
3. Test authentication token management
4. Test error handling for different HTTP status codes
5. Test retry logic for network failures

tasks.title: Update Mobile App Authentication Flow
tasks.description: Modify the mobile app's authentication flow to use the new REST API client instead of gRPC.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the authentication hook
2. Test login, logout, and token persistence
3. Test error handling for authentication failures
4. Test automatic token loading on app start
5. Integration test with the REST API client

tasks.title: Update Mobile App Training Flow
tasks.description: Modify the mobile app's training-related features to use the new REST API client instead of gRPC.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test the training hook
2. Test plan fetching, updating, and feedback submission
3. Test error handling for API failures
4. Test state management for loading and errors
5. Integration test with the REST API client

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling in Mobile App
tasks.description: Update the mobile app's error handling to work with HTTP-specific errors from the REST API.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Unit test error handling for different status codes
2. Test integration with API client error responses
3. Test UI alerts and error messages
4. Test offline handling and retry logic
5. Verify error logging functionality

tasks.title: Implement Integration Tests for REST API
tasks.description: Create comprehensive integration tests for the new REST API endpoints to ensure they match gRPC functionality.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Set up isolated test database for integration tests
2. Create test fixtures for users, training plans, etc.
3. Test each endpoint for success and failure cases
4. Verify response formats match expected schemas
5. Test authentication and authorization rules

tasks.title: Implement Parallel Running of gRPC and REST
tasks.description: Configure the server to run both gRPC and REST APIs in parallel during the transition period.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test server startup with both APIs enabled
2. Verify that both APIs can be accessed simultaneously
3. Test graceful shutdown of both servers
4. Load test to ensure performance is maintained
5. Verify logging captures API usage correctly

tasks.title: Implement Feature Flag for API Selection in Mobile App
tasks.description: Add a feature flag system to the mobile app to control which API (gRPC or REST) is used.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test feature flag initialization and persistence
2. Test API client factory with different flag values
3. Test runtime switching between API types
4. Verify that the correct client is used based on the flag
5. Test remote configuration of flags if implemented

tasks.title: Implement Cleanup and gRPC Deprecation
tasks.description: After successful migration, remove gRPC code and dependencies from the codebase.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify that all gRPC code has been removed
2. Test that the application builds without gRPC dependencies
3. Run the full test suite to ensure functionality is maintained
4. Verify that documentation is updated
5. Perform a final end-to-end test of the application
